<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_one_extend_definition_attribute"><sys_one_extend_definition_attribute action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><advanced>false</advanced><apply_filter>false</apply_filter><attribute_label/><capability display_value="PD sensative data info">17f97bef2b034358b31cf96cfe91bf60</capability><choice_list/><contains_large_input>false</contains_large_input><data_type>string</data_type><default_value>{ "check_sys_id": "2527ddba2b2ac7943238fa912991bf46", "table": "sys_email_log", "groupBy": "notification", "group": "faf480d11b9c7154359b6c46604bcb35", "fields": [ "email.body_text", "email.subject" ], "ai_prompt": null, "records": [ { "sys_id": "375944672b078b18b31cf96cfe91bfb9", "values": { "email.body_text": " A MESSAGE FROM THE DAMM support team

 ACTION NEEDED: Manual System Decommission Needed

 Hi AMEIR,

Your application APM0014659 USPe ARC includes servers not supported by the Service-Now/DAMM server decommission automation and will require manual removal by the application team.

If these are not self-supported hosts, please reach out to the DAMM support team for additional information. Otherwise, please follow the instructions below:

Self-Supported hosts

Self-Supported assets generally mean at some point a decision maker from the application opted out of standard ITO Support, thereby assuming responsibility for system level care. Due to this restriction, the decom SA teams cannot access the server to perform the proper decommission steps.

For self-supported assets, someone from the application team (with root access) will need to personally follow the steps below

 1. Submit EBR (Backup) request if applicable.
 2. Submit Monitoring (Patrol) request if applicable.
 3. If SAN storage is attached, submit a reclaim SRTS or CORE request
 4. Power down the host.
 5. Submit a request to remove the host from DNS (User DNS Request Forms [http://eiss-dns.it.att.com/cgi-bin/UserRequest.cgi])
 6. Alert the IEDS or WITT Team that the applicable steps above are complete and request a change to the status of the device(s) to “Decommissioned”, providing the date the device was shutdown. 
 Non-Windows: IEDS User Email [mailto:g11072@att.com]
 Windows: Submit a USH ticket [https://ushportal.it.att.com/step3.cfm?home=ush&app=2280&is_sbc=&prob=36467]

Note: Some of the first 3 steps may not be required depending on the server, however steps 4-6 will always be necessary.

For Physical servers: Once the above steps are complete and the asset properly reflects decommissioned / retired in all databases, it can be submitted into the ID3 Tool as a Pickup Request following the instructions below.

Steps to submit a self-supported physical server for pickup

 1. Access the Integrated Decommission System (ID3) portal [https://id3.it.att.com/].
 2. Select ‘Pick Up’ under automated services.
 3. Fully complete all the necessary fields in the request and hit attest and submit records when complete.
 4. The assets will be added to the next EDCI Project.
The EDCI team will physically remove all power, fiber, and network cables and the asset will be removed from the data center and destroyed.

If you have any questions about this process, please reach out to the DAMM Support Team [mailto:g03709@att.com?subject=Server%20Decommission%20Help] or the ITO Decommission Team. [mailto:g21307@att.com]

Please click on the link below to view the list of servers to be decommissioned.

View servers to be manually decommissioned [https://attsandboxup.service-now.com/now/nav/ui/classic/params/target/x_att2_damm_decommission_list.do%3Fsysparm_query%3Dstate%253Dmanual_removal%255Ebusiness_application%253D95c35a0a87aa349066c20d4acebb358b]

 Thank you for helping optimize AT&T cost structure.

DAMM Support Team 

 Questions? Please view our in SharePoint here [https://att.sharepoint.com/sites/apprat].

AT&T Proprietary (Internal Use Only). Not for use or disclosure outside the AT&T companies except under written agreement.

 DAMM-53

Self-Supported assets generally mean at some point a decision maker from the application opted out of standard ITO Support, thereby assuming responsibility for system level care. Due to this restriction, the decom SA teams cannot access the server to perform the proper decommission steps.

For self-supported assets, someone from the application team (with root access) will need to personally follow the steps below

 1. Submit EBR (Backup) request if applicable.
 2. Submit Monitoring (Patrol) request if applicable.
 3. If SAN storage is attached, submit a reclaim SRTS or CORE request
 4. Power down the host.
 5. Submit a request to remove the host from DNS (User DNS Request Forms [http://eiss-dns.it.att.com/cgi-bin/UserRequest.cgi])
 6. Alert the IEDS or WITT Team that the applicable steps above are complete and request a change to the status of the device(s) to “Decommissioned”, providing the date the device was shutdown. 
 Non-Windows: IEDS User Email [mailto:g11072@att.com]
 Windows: Submit a USH ticket [https://ushportal.it.att.com/step3.cfm?home=ush&app=2280&is_sbc=&prob=36467]

Note: Some of the first 3 steps may not be required depending on the server, however steps 4-6 will always be necessary.

For Physical servers: Once the above steps are complete and the asset properly reflects decommissioned / retired in all databases, it can be submitted into the ID3 Tool as a Pickup Request following the instructions below.

Steps to submit a self-supported physical server for pickup

 1. Access the Integrated Decommission System (ID3) portal [https://id3.it.att.com/].
 2. Select ‘Pick Up’ under automated services.
 3. Fully complete all the necessary fields in the request and hit attest and submit records when complete.
 4. The assets will be added to the next EDCI Project.
The EDCI team will physically remove all power, fiber, and network cables and the asset will be removed from the data center and destroyed.

If you have any questions about this process, please reach out to the DAMM Support Team [mailto:g03709@att.com?subject=Server%20Decommission%20Help] or the ITO Decommission Team. [mailto:g21307@att.com]

Please click on the link below to view the list of servers to be decommissioned.

View servers to be manually decommissioned [https://attsandboxup.service-now.com/now/nav/ui/classic/params/target/x_att2_damm_decommission_list.do%3Fsysparm_query%3Dstate%253Dmanual_removal%255Ebusiness_application%253D99635e8687aa349066c20d4acebb3598]

 Thank you for helping optimize AT&T cost structure.

DAMM Support Team 

 Questions? Please view our in SharePoint here [https://att.sharepoint.com/sites/apprat].

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_generative_ai_config"><sys_generative_ai_config action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><additional_configurations>{"skill_config_id":"7ff9fbef2b034358b31cf96cfe91bff1"}</additional_configurations><ai_suggested>false</ai_suggested><definition>2ff9bbef2b034358b31cf96cfe91bf90</definition><definition_table>sys_one_extend_capability_definition</definition_table><documentation/><max_tokens>500</max_tokens><min_word_count>-1</min_word_count><model>llm_generic_small</model><name>data analysis</name><parent/><prompt>You are a security and data-governance analyst. You are given an email log payload (Analysis Payload) and have access to a tool, verifySensitiveData, that runs deterministic pattern checks against the SAME payload and returns masked evidence.
Analysis Payload (JSON): {{analysis_payload}}
Steps: 1. Call the verifySensitiveData tool with this same payload. 2. The tool returns: { admin_condition, findings: [ { email_sys_id, has_sensitive_data, matches: [ { type, masked_value } ] } ] }. - "matches[].type" is one of: username, password, api_key, access_token, auth_token_or_secret, card_details, admin_condition. - "matches[].masked_value" is already masked - never attempt to unmask it or reconstruct the raw value, even using the raw subject/body in the payload. 3. If admin_condition is present, treat it as the HIGHEST PRIORITY rule (the 6th, administrator-defined condition) - evaluate it before, and with priority over, the 5 standard categories for every email. 4. Use the raw subject/body in the Analysis Payload only for CONTEXT, to judge whether a tool match is a real, exploitable secret (e.g. a genuine credential) versus a false positive (e.g. a generic word, placeholder, or public value). Do not report anything the tool did not already find a match for.
For EACH email_sys_id in the tool's findings, decide: - classification: one of username | password | api_key | access_token | auth_token_or_secret | card_details | admin_condition | multiple | none - confidence: number from 0 to 1 - severity: one of low | medium | high | critical - status: - "no_issues_found" when has_sensitive_data is false and admin_condition didn't match - "needs_review" when matches exist but context makes them ambiguous/likely false positive - "flagged" when a real sensitive-data exposure is confirmed - masked_evidence: reuse the tool's masked_value(s) for that email (comma-separate if multiple), or empty string - remediation: short, actionable guidance, or empty string
NEVER output a raw/complete password, API key, token, or card number under any circumstance - only the tool's masked_value strings.
Respond with STRICT JSON ONLY (no markdown, no commentary), an ARRAY with one object per email_sys_id, exactly this shape: [ { "email_sys_id": "...", "status": "no_issues_found | needs_review | flagged", "classification": "username | password | api_key | access_token | auth_token_or_secret | card_details | admin_condition | multiple | none", "confidence": 0.0, "severity": "low | medium | high | critical", "masked_evidence": "...", "remediation": "..." } ]</prompt><prompt_template_role>user</prompt_template_role><provider_company/><request_tokens>32018</request_tokens><show_in_prompt_library>false</show_in_prompt_library><state>draft</state><structured_output_enabled>false</structured_output_enabled><structured_output_schema/><sys_class_name>sys_generative_ai_config</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>yg991f</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-07 07:31:38</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>abf9bbef2b034358b31cf96cfe91bfd7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>2ff9bbef2b034358b31cf96cfe91bf90</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services" source="x_att2_fir_net_mob">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_generative_ai_config_abf9bbef2b034358b31cf96cfe91bfd7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>yg991f</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-07 09:45:56</sys_updated_on><temperature>0.2</temperature><thinking_tokens>0</thinking_tokens><version>1</version></sys_generative_ai_config></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_generative_ai_config"><sys_generative_ai_config action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><additional_configurations>{"skill_config_id":"3151092a2b4743943238fa912991bf72"}</additional_configurations><ai_suggested>false</ai_suggested><definition>7151c52a2b4743943238fa912991bfb6</definition><definition_table>sys_one_extend_capability_definition</definition_table><documentation/><max_tokens>500</max_tokens><min_word_count>-1</min_word_count><model>llm_generic_small</model><name>duplicate</name><parent/><prompt>You are the Platform Doctor Duplicate Analyzer. You are given pre-computed analysis data: a list of already-confirmed exact duplicate groups (100% certain, no judgment needed) plus a list of candidate overlaps that need your judgment. Each candidate item's administrator guidance is in its own "ai_prompt" field.
ANALYSIS DATA: {{Analyzer.output}}
Instructions: 1. Copy every entry in "finalized_exact_groups" AS-IS into your final output - do not alter them. 2. For each item in "pending_overlap_review", and each pair in that item's "candidate_overlaps", decide - using that item's ai_prompt, the pair's "shared_clauses" (specific overlapping encoded-query clauses), and "differing_fields" - whether it's a meaningful overlap ("overlap") or should be dropped as unrelated. Assign a confidence 0-100. In "reason", name the specific shared clause(s). 3. Drop any pair that item's ai_prompt says to exclude (tables, applications, packages, scopes). 4. For every retained overlap, build an entry with: group_id (e.g. "<check_sys_id>.<group>.overlap<index>"), table, match_type "overlap", sys_ids (the pair), confidence, reason (which fields matched/differed and why), and recommendation. 5. Combine the copied exact groups (step 1) and your judged overlap entries (step 4) into one array. 6. Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, no code fences, no explanation, with exactly this one top-level key: {"duplicate_groups":[{"group_id":"<string>","table":"<string>","match_type":"exact|overlap","sys_ids":["..."],"confidence":<0-100>,"reason":"<string>","recommendation":"<string>"}]} 7. Read "min_confidence" from the analysis data. After judging all overlaps, drop any entry (exact or overlap) whose confidence is below min_confidence before returning duplicate_groups.</prompt><prompt_template_role>user</prompt_template_role><provider_company/><request_tokens>32018</request_tokens><show_in_prompt_library>true</show_in_prompt_library><state>published</state><structured_output_enabled>false</structured_output_enabled><structured_output_schema/><sys_class_name>sys_generative_ai_config</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>yg991f</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 15:30:57</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>b151092a2b4743943238fa912991bf0b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>17</sys_mod_count><sys_name>7151c52a2b4743943238fa912991bfb6</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services" source="x_att2_fir_net_mob">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_generative_ai_config_b151092a2b4743943238fa912991bf0b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>yg991f</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-04 13:49:34</sys_updated_on><temperature>0.2</temperature><thinking_tokens>0</thinking_tokens><version>1</version></sys_generative_ai_config></record_update>

DATA: {{Analyzer.output}}
Rules: 1. Keep every "finalized_exact_groups" entry unchanged. 2. For each "pending_overlap_review" item, evaluate each "candidate_overlaps" pair's "shared_clauses": - FLAG as overlap (do not drop) if any shared clause contains a specific value a sys_id, a named cat_item/assignment_group/table, or a literal comparison value (e.g. "cat_item=<sys_id>", "assignment_group.nameSTARTSWITHASG-FITTREX"). - DROP only if every shared clause is a generic/common fragment with no specific value (e.g. "work_notesVALCHANGES", "commentsVALCHANGES", "assigned_toISNOTEMPTY", "assigned_toVALCHANGES", "requested_forISNOTEMPTY", presence/change checks with nothing specific attached). - Also drop anything ai_prompt explicitly excludes. - Assign confidence 90 for specific-value matches, 60 for borderline/multiple-generic-clause matches. Do not assign confidence based on subjective judgment beyond these rules. 3. Build overlap entries: group_id ("<check_sys_id>.<group>.overlap<i>"), table, match_type "overlap", sys_ids, confidence, reason (max 8 words, name the shared clause), recommendation (max 6 words). 4. Merge exact + overlap entries. Drop any entry with confidence below "min_confidence". 5. Output ONLY this JSON, no markdown, no extra text: { 'duplicate_groups': [ { 'group_id': '', 'table': '', 'match_type': 'exact|overlap', 'sys_ids': [], 'confidence': 0, 'reason': '', 'recommendation': '' } ] }</prompt><prompt_template_role>user</prompt_template_role><provider_company/><request_tokens>27518</request_tokens><show_in_prompt_library>false</show_in_prompt_library><state>draft</state><structured_output_enabled>false</structured_output_enabled><structured_output_schema/><sys_class_name>sys_generative_ai_config</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>yg991f</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-04 15:52:49</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>73efc6faeb4b871816f8ff7cbad0cd5a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>11</sys_mod_count><sys_name>7151c52a2b4743943238fa912991bfb6</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services" source="x_att2_fir_net_mob">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_generative_ai_config_73efc6faeb4b871816f8ff7cbad0cd5a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>pm6198</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-07 09:36:38</sys_updated_on><temperature>0.2</temperature><thinking_tokens>0</thinking_tokens><version>2</version></sys_generative_ai_config></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="DELETE"><access>package_private</access><active>false</active><api_name>x_att2_fir_net_mob.platformDoctorDuplicateAnalyzer</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>platformDoctorDuplicateAnalyzer</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var platformDoctorDuplicateAnalyzer = Class.create();
platformDoctorDuplicateAnalyzer.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        this.checklistTable = 'x_att2_fir_net_mob_governace_checklist';
        // Comma-separated scope/package/table names to always exclude, on top of
        // whatever the checklist's own ai_prompt tells the LLM to exclude.
        this.excludedScopes = this._parseList(
            gs.getProperty('x_att2_fir_net_mob.duplicate_analysis.excluded_scopes', ''));
        this.excludedPackages = this._parseList(
            gs.getProperty('x_att2_fir_net_mob.duplicate_analysis.excluded_packages', ''));
        // Admin-configurable minimum confidence (0-100) a duplicate_groups entry
        // must meet to be returned. Exact duplicates (always 100) are filtered
        // here directly; the same threshold is surfaced to the prompt so it can
        // apply it to LLM-judged overlap confidences too.
        this.minConfidence = parseInt(
            gs.getProperty('x_att2_fir_net_mob.duplicate_analysis.min_confidence', '80'), 10) || 80;
    },

    /**
     * Entry point for the Skill2 "Choose existing script" tool
     * (Script function: analyze). Accepts the full stringified result of
     * platformDoctorUtils.run()/runForCheck() -
     * {duplicatePayload:[...], findingsPayload:[...], nonDuplicatePayload:[...]} -
     * and runs the exact-duplicate/candidate-overlap analysis on every entry in
     * duplicatePayload.
     *
     * Exact duplicates are 100%-certain and need no AI judgment, so they come
     * back already finalized in the exact shape the skill's "duplicate_groups"
     * output expects. "pending_overlap_review" holds the smaller, genuinely
     * ambiguous candidate overlaps for the prompt to judge. The skill's prompt
     * combines both into the final "duplicate_groups" output in one response.
     *
     * Also accepts a single flat group object directly
     * ({check_sys_id, table, groupBy, group, fields, ai_prompt, records}) for
     * backward compatibility / one-off testing.
     *
     * @param {string} payloadJson stringified wrapper or single group object
     * @returns {string} stringified analysis result
     */
    analyze: function(payloadJson) {
        var payload;
        try {
            payload = JSON.parse(this._sanitizeJson(payloadJson));
        } catch (e) {
            return JSON.stringify({
                status: 'error',
                error: 'Invalid payload JSON: ' + e.message,
                errorCode: 'E_INVALID_PAYLOAD'
            });
        }

        var groups = this._extractGroups(payload);
        if (!groups.length) {
            return JSON.stringify({
                status: 'error',
                error: 'Payload missing duplicatePayload/table/records',
                errorCode: 'E_EMPTY_PAYLOAD'
            });
        }

        var checklistCache = {};
        var finalizedExactGroups = [];
        var pendingOverlapReview = [];

        for (var i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
            var group = groups[i];
            if (!group || !group.table || !group.records || !group.records.length) {
                continue;
            }

            if (!checklistCache.hasOwnProperty(group.check_sys_id)) {
                checklistCache[group.check_sys_id] = this._getChecklistConfig(group.check_sys_id);
            }

            var analyzed = this._analyzeGroup(group, checklistCache[group.check_sys_id]);
            finalizedExactGroups = finalizedExactGroups.concat(analyzed.exact_duplicate_groups);

            if (analyzed.candidate_overlaps.length) {
                pendingOverlapReview.push({
                    check_sys_id: group.check_sys_id,
                    table: group.table,
                    group: group.group,
                    ai_prompt: group.ai_prompt || '',
                    candidate_overlaps: analyzed.candidate_overlaps
                });
            }
        }

        finalizedExactGroups = finalizedExactGroups.filter(function(g) {
            return g.confidence >= this.minConfidence;
        }, this);

        return JSON.stringify({
            status: 'success',
            group_count: groups.length,
            min_confidence: this.minConfidence,
            finalized_exact_groups: finalizedExactGroups,
            pending_overlap_review: pendingOverlapReview
        });
    },

    /**
     * Normalize the incoming payload into an array of flat group objects,
     * whether it's the full {duplicatePayload:[...]} wrapper or a single
     * flat group passed directly.
     */
    _extractGroups: function(payload) {
        if (!payload) {
            return [];
        }
        if (payload.duplicatePayload instanceof Array) {
            return payload.duplicatePayload;
        }
        if (payload.table && payload.records) {
            return [payload];
        }
        return [];
    },

    /**
     * Repair malformed JSON text so hand-pasted/test payloads (and any future
     * upstream data) still parse: (1) stray single backslashes that aren't
     * valid JSON escapes, e.g. from regex fragments like [a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]
     * embedded in encoded query conditions, get doubled; (2) raw control
     * characters (literal newlines/tabs/etc.) found inside string literals
     * get escaped to \n/\t/etc. Whitespace between tokens (outside strings) is
     * left untouched. Real payloads built via JSON.stringify() already escape
     * everything correctly and pass through unchanged.
     */
    _sanitizeJson: function(raw) {
        raw = String(raw || '');
        var validEscapes = { '"': 1, '\\': 1, '/': 1, 'b': 1, 'f': 1, 'n': 1, 'r': 1, 't': 1, 'u': 1 };
        var result = '';
        var inString = false;

        for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
            var ch = raw.charAt(i);
            var code = raw.charCodeAt(i);

            if (ch === '\\') {
                var next = raw.charAt(i + 1);
                if (inString && !validEscapes[next]) {
                    // Stray backslash inside a string (e.g. regex \- \.): escape it,
                    // leave the following character to be processed normally.
                    result += '\\\\';
                    continue;
                }
                result += ch;
                if (next) {
                    result += next;
                    i++;
                }
                continue;
            }

            if (ch === '"') {
                inString = !inString;
                result += ch;
                continue;
            }

            if (inString && code < 0x20) {
                switch (ch) {
                    case '\n': result += '\\n'; break;
                    case '\r': result += '\\r'; break;
                    case '\t': result += '\\t'; break;
                    case '\b': result += '\\b'; break;
                    case '\f': result += '\\f'; break;
                    default: result += '\\u' + ('0000' + code.toString(16)).slice(-4);
                }
                continue;
            }

            result += ch;
        }

        return result;
    },

    /**
     * Run the enrich/filter/exact-duplicate/candidate-overlap analysis for a
     * single flat group object. Exact duplicates come back already finalized
     * in the skill's "duplicate_groups" output shape (no LLM needed); candidate
     * overlaps come back compact/raw for the LLM to judge.
     */
    _analyzeGroup: function(group, checklistCfg) {
        var enriched = this._enrichAndFilter(group, checklistCfg);

        var exactDuplicates = this._findExactDuplicates(enriched.kept, group.fields);
        var groupedSysIds = this._flattenSysIds(exactDuplicates);
        var remaining = enriched.kept.filter(function(r) {
            return groupedSysIds.indexOf(r.sys_id) === -1;
        });
        var candidateOverlaps = this._findCandidateOverlaps(remaining, group.fields);

        return {
            exact_duplicate_groups: this._finalizeExactDuplicates(group, exactDuplicates),
            candidate_overlaps: candidateOverlaps
        };
    },

    /**
     * Format each exact-duplicate signature bucket into the final
     * "duplicate_groups" entry shape - ready to merge downstream, no LLM pass needed.
     */
    _finalizeExactDuplicates: function(group, exactDuplicates) {
        return exactDuplicates.map(function(dup, idx) {
            return {
                group_id: group.check_sys_id + '.' + group.group + '.exact' + idx,
                table: group.table,
                match_type: 'exact',
                sys_ids: dup.sys_ids,
                confidence: 100,
                reason: 'Identical values across configured comparison field(s): ' + group.fields.join(', ') + '.',
                recommendation: 'Merge or remove the redundant duplicate record(s).'
            };
        });
    },


    /**
     * Look up the checklist row (package/scope exclusion hints live alongside
     * the AI prompt today; extend here if dedicated exclusion fields get added).
     */
    _getChecklistConfig: function(checklistId) {
        var cfg = { sys_id: checklistId, aiPrompt: '' };
        if (!checklistId) {
            return cfg;
        }
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.checklistTable);
        if (gr.get(checklistId)) {
            cfg.aiPrompt = gr.getValue('u_ai_prompt') || '';
        }
        return cfg;
    },

    /**
     * Re-query each record by sys_id to pull scope/package/class, drop anything
     * excluded by scope/package, and keep the original comparison field values.
     */
    _enrichAndFilter: function(payload, checklistCfg) {
        var kept = [];
        var excludedCount = 0;

        var ids = payload.records.map(function(r) { return r.sys_id; });
        if (!ids.length) {
            return { kept: kept, excludedCount: excludedCount };
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecord(payload.table);
        gr.addQuery('sys_id', 'IN', ids.join(','));
        gr.query();

        var meta = {};
        while (gr.next()) {
            meta[gr.getUniqueValue()] = {
                scope: gr.getValue('sys_scope'),
                package: gr.getValue('sys_package'),
                className: gr.getValue('sys_class_name')
            };
        }

        for (var i = 0; i < payload.records.length; i++) {
            var rec = payload.records[i];
            var m = meta[rec.sys_id] || {};

            if (this.excludedScopes.indexOf(m.scope) !== -1 ||
                this.excludedPackages.indexOf(m.package) !== -1) {
                excludedCount++;
                continue;
            }

            kept.push({
                sys_id: rec.sys_id,
                values: rec.values,
                scope: m.scope || '',
                package: m.package || ''
            });
        }

        return { kept: kept, excludedCount: excludedCount };
    },

    /**
     * Exact duplicates: identical values across every configured comparison field.
     */
    _findExactDuplicates: function(records, fields) {
        var buckets = {};
        for (var i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
            var key = this._signature(records[i].values, fields);
            if (!buckets[key]) {
                buckets[key] = [];
            }
            buckets[key].push(records[i]);
        }

        var groups = [];
        for (var k in buckets) {
            if (buckets[k].length >= 2) {
                groups.push({
                    signature: k,
                    sys_ids: buckets[k].map(function(r) { return r.sys_id; }),
                    matching_fields: fields
                });
            }
        }
        return groups;
    },

    /**
     * Candidate overlaps: pairwise comparison of the remaining (non-exact) records.
     * A pair is flagged when either (a) at least half the configured fields match
     * whole-value (the original multi-field heuristic), or (b) any field's value
     * shares at least one encoded-query clause (split on "^") with the other
     * record - this is what surfaces near-duplicates when only one field (e.g.
     * "condition") is configured, since two conditions rarely match end-to-end
     * but often share a redundant clause (e.g. the same assignment_group or
     * cat_item check embedded in an otherwise different filter).
     */
    _findCandidateOverlaps: function(records, fields) {
        var candidates = [];
        var minMatches = Math.ceil(fields.length / 2) || 1;

        for (var i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
            for (var j = i + 1; j < records.length; j++) {
                var diff = this._diffFields(records[i].values, records[j].values, fields);
                var sharedClauses = this._sharedClauses(records[i].values, records[j].values, fields);
                var wholeFieldMatch = diff.matching.length >= minMatches && diff.differing.length;

                if (wholeFieldMatch || sharedClauses.length) {
                    candidates.push({
                        sys_ids: [records[i].sys_id, records[j].sys_id],
                        matching_fields: diff.matching,
                        differing_fields: diff.differing,
                        shared_clauses: sharedClauses
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        return candidates;
    },

    /**
     * Split each configured field's value into "^"-separated encoded-query
     * clauses (dropping bare "EQ"/"NQ"/"OR" separators) and return the list of
     * clauses that appear in both records' values, across all fields.
     */
    _sharedClauses: function(valuesA, valuesB, fields) {
        var shared = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
            var a = this._clauses(valuesA[fields[i]]);
            var b = this._clauses(valuesB[fields[i]]);
            for (var x = 0; x < a.length; x++) {
                if (b.indexOf(a[x]) !== -1 && shared.indexOf(a[x]) === -1) {
                    shared.push(a[x]);
                }
            }
        }
        return shared;
    },

    _clauses: function(value) {
        return String(value || '').split('^').map(function(c) {
            return c.trim();
        }).filter(function(c) {
            return c && c !== 'EQ' && c !== 'NQ' && c !== 'OR';
        });
    },

    _diffFields: function(valuesA, valuesB, fields) {
        var matching = [];
        var differing = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
            var f = fields[i];
            if ((valuesA[f] || '') === (valuesB[f] || '')) {
                matching.push(f);
            } else {
                differing.push(f);
            }
        }
        return { matching: matching, differing: differing };
    },

    _signature: function(values, fields) {
        var parts = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
            parts.push(fields[i] + '=' + (values[fields[i]] || ''));
        }
        return parts.join('|');
    },

    _flattenSysIds: function(groups) {
        var ids = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
            ids = ids.concat(groups[i].sys_ids);
        }
        return ids;
    },

    _parseList: function(raw) {
        return String(raw || '').split(',').map(function(s) {
            return s.trim();
        }).filter(function(s) {
            return s;
        });
    },

    /**
     * The Flow Designer "Execute Skill" action does NOT auto-promote a
     * skill's custom outputs (e.g. "duplicate_groups") - it only ever returns
     * the generic {provider, response, status, error, errorcode} envelope.
     * The model's real JSON lives inside "response", often further wrapped as
     * a bare 'model_output: "..."' text fragment and multiply re-escaped.
     * This repeatedly unwraps/parses until it finds a real duplicate_groups
     * array, falling back to a tolerant regex extraction as a last resort.
     * @param {(string|Object)} raw the Execute Skill action's raw output (object or JSON string)
     * @returns {Array} duplicate_groups array (empty array if none found)
     */
    extractDuplicateGroups: function(raw) {
        gs.info('[PD] extractDuplicateGroups raw typeof=' + (typeof raw) + ' value=' + JSON.stringify(raw));

        var found = this._digForDuplicateGroups(raw, 0);
        gs.info('[PD] extractDuplicateGroups _digForDuplicateGroups found=' + JSON.stringify(found));
        if (found) {
            return found;
        }

        // Last resort: regex-extract "duplicate_groups":[...] directly from the raw text.
        var text = (typeof raw === 'string') ? raw : JSON.stringify(raw || '');
        var match = text.match(/"duplicate_groups"\s*:\s*(\[[\s\S]*?\])(?=\s*[,}]|\s*$)/);
        if (match) {
            try {
                var unescaped = match[1];
                var prev;
                do {
                    prev = unescaped;
                    unescaped = unescaped.replace(/\\\\/g, '\\').replace(/\\"/g, '"');
                } while (unescaped !== prev);
                var result = JSON.parse(unescaped);
                return result instanceof Array ? result : [];
            } catch (e3) {
                return [];
            }
        }

        return [];
    },

    /**
     * Recursively search any object/array/string-encoded-JSON structure, at
     * any nesting depth and shape, for a "duplicate_groups" array. Handles
     * every wrapper variant the Execute Skill action has produced so far:
     * {response:{model_output:"..."}}, {response:"..."}, arrays wrapping the
     * object, and any combination/depth of those, without depending on
     * specific key names beyond "duplicate_groups" itself.
     */
    _digForDuplicateGroups: function(node, depth) {
        if (depth > 8 || node === null || node === undefined) {
            return null;
        }

        if (node instanceof Array) {
            for (var i = 0; i < node.length; i++) {
                var foundInArray = this._digForDuplicateGroups(node[i], depth + 1);
                if (foundInArray) {
                    return foundInArray;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        if (typeof node === 'object') {
            if (node.duplicate_groups instanceof Array) {
                return node.duplicate_groups;
            }
            for (var key in node) {
                if (!node.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                    continue;
                }
                var foundInProp = this._digForDuplicateGroups(node[key], depth + 1);
                if (foundInProp) {
                    return foundInProp;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        if (typeof node === 'string') {
            var stripped = node.replace(/^\s*"model_output"\s*:\s*/, '');
            var parsed = null;
            try {
                parsed = JSON.parse(this._sanitizeJson(stripped));
            } catch (e1) {
                try {
                    parsed = JSON.parse(this._sanitizeJson(node));
                } catch (e2) {
                    parsed = null;
                }
            }
            if (parsed !== null && typeof parsed === 'object') {
                return this._digForDuplicateGroups(parsed, depth + 1);
            }
        }

        return null;
    },

    /**
     * Convenience wrapper for the Flow "Duplicate HTML format" Script step:
     * takes the Execute Skill action's raw output (bind the whole "output"
     * object, not the nested "duplicate groups" child, which is always null),
     * extracts duplicate_groups tolerantly, and renders the HTML report.
     * @param {(string|Object)} rawSkillOutput Execute Skill action's raw output
     * @returns {string} "[code]<html>...</html>[/code]"
     */
    buildWorkNotesHtmlFromSkillOutput: function(rawSkillOutput) {
        return this.buildWorkNotesHtml(this.extractDuplicateGroups(rawSkillOutput));
    },

    /**
     * Render a skill's "duplicate_groups" output (array or JSON string) into
     * an HTML report wrapped in [code]...[/code] so it renders as rich HTML
     * (not escaped plain text) when posted to a Work Notes/journal field.
     * @param {(Array|string)} duplicateGroups parsed array or JSON string of
     *   {group_id, table, match_type, sys_ids, confidence, reason, recommendation}
     * @returns {string} "[code]<html>...</html>[/code]"
     */
    buildWorkNotesHtml: function(duplicateGroups) {
        if (typeof duplicateGroups === 'string') {
            try {
                duplicateGroups = JSON.parse(duplicateGroups);
            } catch (e) {
                duplicateGroups = [];
            }
        }
        duplicateGroups = duplicateGroups || [];

        if (!duplicateGroups.length) {
            return '[code]<p>No duplicate or overlapping records were found for this check.</p>[/code]';
        }

        var self = this;
        var rows = duplicateGroups.map(function(g) {
            return '<tr>' +
                '<td>' + self._escapeHtml(g.group_id) + '</td>' +
                '<td>' + self._escapeHtml(g.table) + '</td>' +
                '<td>' + self._escapeHtml(g.match_type) + '</td>' +
                '<td>' + self._escapeHtml(g.confidence) + '</td>' +
                '<td>' + self._escapeHtml((g.sys_ids || []).join(', ')) + '</td>' +
                '<td>' + self._escapeHtml(g.reason) + '</td>' +
                '<td>' + self._escapeHtml(g.recommendation) + '</td>' +
                '</tr>';
        }).join('');

        var html =
            '<table border="1" cellpadding="4" cellspacing="0" style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;">' +
            '<thead><tr>' +
            '<th>Group ID</th><th>Table</th><th>Match Type</th><th>Confidence</th>' +
            '<th>Sys IDs</th><th>Reason</th><th>Recommendation</th>' +
            '</tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table>';

        return '[code]' + html + '[/code]';
    },

    _escapeHtml: function(value) {
        return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value)
            .replace(/&/g, '&')
            .replace(/</g, '<')
            .replace(/>/g, '>')
            .replace(/"/g, '"');
    },

    type: 'platformDoctorDuplicateAnalyzer'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>yg991f</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-03 15:37:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>47c2096a2b8743943238fa912991bfa4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>16</sys_mod_count><sys_name>platformDoctorDuplicateAnalyzer</sys_name><sys_package display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services" source="x_att2_fir_net_mob">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_47c2096a2b8743943238fa912991bfa4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>yg991f</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-04 15:17:19</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="CSM default record page">e161e1fa2bc3cb546828f10b0991bf69</macroponent><name>set shn actionSysId</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
async function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    const actionItems = event?.payload?.data?.GlideViewQuery_Query?.uiView?.glideLayoutItem?._query?.GlideUxActionLayout_Query?.getActionLayout?.actionLayoutItems;
    const length = actionItems.length;
    let shnActionItem = null;
    for(let i = 0;i < length;i++){
        const actionItem = actionItems[i];
        if(actionItem.name && actionItem.name.toLowerCase() === "special handling notes"){
            shnActionItem = actionItem;
            break;
        }
    }
    api.setState('shnActionSysId', shnActionItem?.sysId);
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>pm6198</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-04 12:29:30</sys_created_on><sys_id>716125fa2bc3cb546828f10b0991bf4b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>set shn actionSysId</sys_name><sys_package display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services" source="x_att2_fir_net_mob">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_716125fa2bc3cb546828f10b0991bf4b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>pm6198</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-04 12:29:30</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="List Menu Template Page">0033553a2bc78b546828f10b0991bfde</macroponent><name>Refresh List</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function handler({
      api,
      event: {
          payload,
          payload: {
              name,
              value,
              previousValue
          }
      },
      helpers,
      imports
    }) {
      
      if (name === 'screen' &&
          value.isActive != previousValue.isActive
          && value.isActive
          && api.state.hasRecordChanges) {
            api.setState('hasRecordChanges', false);
            api.data.list_controller.refreshRequested({
                hideLoader: true
            });     
      }
      if (name === 'activityLogs' && value && value.size > 0) {
        const operationList = ['modified', 'updated', 'inserted', 'deleted', 'closed'];
        // Transform "value" and get the latest entry
        const map = Array.from(value).pop()[1];
        const crudActivitiesLength = map.activities.get('crud').length;
        if (crudActivitiesLength < 1)
            return;
        const {
            operation,
            sysId,
            timestamp
        } = map.activities.get('crud')[crudActivitiesLength - 1];
        if (operationList.includes(operation) &&
            sysId !== "-1" &&
            !api.context.props.screen.isActive &&
            !api.state.hasRecordChanges) {
            api.setState('hasRecordChanges', true);
        }
    }
    }]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>pm6198</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-04 11:27:24</sys_created_on><sys_id>9033953a2bc78b546828f10b0991bf57</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Refresh List</sys_name><sys_package display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services" source="x_att2_fir_net_mob">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_9033953a2bc78b546828f10b0991bf57</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>pm6198</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-04 11:27:24</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

*/
async function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    if(api.data.get_special_handling_notes_1 && api.data.get_special_handling_notes_1.output){
        api.setState('Totalmsg', api.data.get_special_handling_notes_1.output.data.GlideSHN_Query.totalMsg);

                                status: 'info',
                                icon: 'circle-exclamation-outline',
                                content: await helpers.translate('No special handling notes available'),
                                action: {
                                    type: 'dismiss'
                                }
                            }]
                        });
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>pm6198</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-04 12:29:30</sys_created_on><sys_id>fd6125fa2bc3cb546828f10b0991bf4e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Shn Totalmsg count</sys_name><sys_package display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services" source="x_att2_fir_net_mob">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FirstNet & Mobility Integration Services">58181ef7977a62d0aa26b5f0f053af4c</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_fd6125fa2bc3cb546828f10b0991bf4e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>pm6198</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-04 12:29:30</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
